items.title: Oltre la polemica sul paesismo: la restanza come vertenza politica
items.subtitle: Superare la retorica dei paesi come rifugi o luoghi di arretratezza per difendere i diritti.
items.original_title: Dalla parte dei paesi: oltre la polemica tra Raimo e Arminio
items.summary: Il dibattito pubblico sui piccoli paesi oscilla costantemente tra la condanna per l'arretratezza e la mitizzazione bucolica, riducendo i territori a oggetti di consumo culturale o a mercati turistici. Per uscire da questa retorica del paesismo occorre un'analisi antropologica rigorosa e trasformare la restanza in una vera e propria battaglia politica per i diritti di cittadinanza e il welfare.
bullets: Il dibattito tra chi condanna l'Italia rurale e chi la sacralizza condivide lo stesso vizio: giudicare i territori attraverso fantasie e stereotipi anziché come luoghi reali attraversati da rapporti di potere e diseguaglianze.

La cultura nei piccoli paesi rischia di diventare un moltiplicatore di diseguaglianze, trasformando i borghi in spazi-mercato che concentrano visibilità e risorse su chi già possiede capitale culturale e mediatico.
Il concetto di restanza deve essere depurato dalla sua deriva contemplativa ed esistenziale per tornare a essere una piattaforma politica e una vertenza collettiva per il diritto a restare.

La scelta di restare o tornare in un paese non è una decisione puramente libera, ma è condizionata dalle politiche statali, dai finanziamenti, dai tagli al welfare e dal contrasto al dissesto idrogeologico.
Mancano nell'agenda politica istituzionale misure strutturali come un reddito di comunità e sostegni mirati per l'imprenditoria giovanile e agricola nei territori marginali.

bullets: Il progetto congiunto tra Wavves e Say Anything è stato interrotto a causa delle accuse rivolte a Max Bemis di aver intrattenuto scambi inappropriati online con una minorenne.

La cancellazione del disco comporta perdite economiche quantificate in circa 200 mila dollari per Williams, inclusi diecimila vinili già pronti e destinati al macero.
Nonostante sia stata valutata l'ipotesi di ri-registrare il materiale escludendo Bemis, l'artista ha ribadito che il disco non vedrà mai la luce nella sua forma attuale.
I rappresentanti dei Say Anything hanno annunciato la cancellazione dei prossimi concerti per permettere a Bemis di concentrarsi sulla propria salute mentale.

Tracks like 'My day at the casino' incorporate conversation fragments from the end of a relationship, shifting from breakdown to an arrangement featuring horns.

items.title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
items.subtitle: Use multidimensional item response theory to audit LLM benchmark questions and signals.
items.original_title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
items.summary: BenchMIRT applies Multidimensional Item Response Theory (MIRT) to audit LLM benchmarks at the individual prompt level. Trained on 100 models across 16 benchmarks and 34,000+ questions, it independently isolates underlying capabilities like safety and general reasoning, revealing mixed signals in popular tests like BBQ and WMDP. The method also enables compressing benchmarks down to 10-50% of their questions while preserving evaluation fidelity.
bullets: BenchMIRT adapts psychometric Item Response Theory (IRT) to estimate model capabilities, question difficulty, and question discrimination across multiple dimensions simultaneously.
Without explicit supervision on capability labels, BenchMIRT independently recovered safety and general reasoning as the two dominant stable dimensions across 16 tested benchmarks.
Analysis of the BBQ social bias benchmark showed it correlates more strongly with general reasoning than safety, indicating low scores may reflect reasoning struggles rather than bias alone.
WMDP dangerous knowledge benchmark scores were inversely associated with general reasoning, because higher reasoning models were more likely to refuse the dangerous requests.
Retaining only 10% of benchmark questions chosen via BenchMIRT's discrimination estimates preserves nearly the same model ranking accuracy as the full test set.
BenchMIRT correctly predicted unobserved model responses on held-out questions 79% of the time, outperforming simple overall-score baselines.

items.title: NVIDIA and CrowdStrike Launch SafeMind Agentic Cybersecurity System

items.summary: CrowdStrike and NVIDIA have announced SafeMind, an agentic cybersecurity system built on NVIDIA Nemotron open models post-trained with CrowdStrike threat data. The platform uses a continuous coevolution loop of red-team and blue-team agents running on a digital twin simulation environment to automate defense against AI-enabled attacks.
bullets: SafeMind combines CrowdStrike custom agentic harnesses with defensive models built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra and Nemotron 3 Super.
The Blue Solano model, based on Nemotron 3 Super, delivered higher accuracy than leading frontier models at 99% lower cost in internal evaluations.
An adversarial red-team harness runs Recon, Assault, and Compromise sub-agents, while blue-team agents validate and promote detections.
The system operates inside a digital twin of NVIDIA's accelerated computing infrastructure to test and harden security via a continuous cat-and-mouse loop.
CrowdStrike also introduced Falcon IQ, powered by Nemotron models, utilizing a workforce of over 50 agents to automate security workflows.

items.title: How a Fabricated 1928 Olympic Race Report Banned Women From Distance Running
items.subtitle: How fake media reports from the 1928 Olympics banned women from running over 200m for decades.
items.original_title: How One Fake Story Kept Women Out of Olympic Distance Running for Decades
items.summary: At the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics, prominent journalists fabricated reports claiming that female runners collapsed from exhaustion during the inaugural women's 800-meter race. These false accounts were weaponized by officials like Pierre de Coubertin and the IAAF to ban women from running distances over 200 meters until 1960.
bullets: All nine runners finished the 1928 Olympic 800-meter race, with the top three breaking the world record and no mass collapse occurring.
Reporters from major outlets like the New York Times and Chicago Tribune invented vivid stories of runners fainting and requiring revival periods.
The International Amateur Athletic Federation voted 12-to-9 to ban the women's 800 meters despite medical testimony that competitive athletics did not injure women.
The Amateur Athletic Union in the United States banned women from all distance races following the 1928 media coverage.
Women's Olympic running distances remained capped at 800 meters until the 1500 meters was introduced in 1972, and the women's marathon did not arrive until 1984.

items.title: How AI plotted an interstellar journey to Alpha Centauri

items.original_title: How AI plotted an interstellar journey to Alpha Centauri
items.summary: The Fermi Explorer Mission plans to launch a $15 million spacecraft to Alpha Centauri by 2029, using a novel trajectory discovered by Physical Superintelligence's open-source AI system. The AI combined orbital maneuvers to leverage close solar passes for maximum thrust using small solar panels, cutting weight and costs.
bullets: The Fermi Explorer Mission aims to launch by 2029 with a budget of $15 million, targeting Alpha Centauri 4.4 light-years away.
Physical Superintelligence (PSI), backed by Breakthrough Energy, utilized its open-source AI system to solve the mission's power-to-weight constraint.
The AI system, running on a billion tokens over three days, devised a trajectory where the spacecraft performs close solar passes inside Mercury's orbit.
During each close pass, the probe fires its engine to exploit high solar intensity, maximizing energy gain while keeping solar panels and weight small.
The mission will carry a one-kilogram payload including scientific instruments and a copy of the Golden Record.

items.title: Mapping global methane emissions from space with deep learning
items.subtitle: How Google and NASA JPL use vision transformers to map facility-scale methane from space.
items.original_title: Mapping global methane emissions from space with deep learning
items.summary: Google Research and NASA JPL developed MAPL-EMIT, a deep-learning framework utilizing a Swin-S vision transformer architecture to automate methane plume detection from satellite hyperspectral data. Trained on 3.6 million physics-simulated synthetic plumes injected into real Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation (EMIT) scenes, the model achieves an 84% recall on expert-annotated plumes while minimizing false positives.
bullets: MAPL-EMIT uses an end-to-end Swin-S vision transformer to analyze both the full spectrum of light and surrounding spatial context, differentiating true wind-blown methane plumes from spectrally similar ground surfaces.
The model simultaneously automates detection, enhancement quantification, and source estimation to resolve overlapping plumes in dense industrial clusters.
Training utilized a physics-based simulation framework with Lagrangian puff models to inject 3.6 million synthetic plumes into real EMIT granules across diverse atmospheric conditions.

Evaluated against NASA's L2B dataset, MAPL-EMIT captures 84% of expert-annotated plumes, identifies roughly 50% more plausible plumes, and successfully maps emissions at 24 of the world's 25 top-emitting landfills.
To handle false positives in complex terrain, outputs are paired with physics-based spectral fit scores, strided inference detection counts, and confidence tagging.

bullets: Replaces static processing (fixed FPS ingestion) with dynamic, goal-directed tool invocation to fetch only required video segments.

items.title: Building an Adaptive Agentic Cybersecurity System with NVIDIA Nemotron
items.subtitle: How NVIDIA and CrowdStrike built an agentic red-blue loop with Nemotron models.
items.original_title: Building an Adaptive Agentic Cybersecurity System with NVIDIA Nemotron
items.summary: NVIDIA and CrowdStrike evaluated an agentic cybersecurity system that automates the red-blue offense-defense feedback loop using specialized open models. The architecture pairs an orchestration model with a fine-tuned detection authoring model, supported by a harness that executes schema validation, telemetry replay, and artifact linting. In live-fire evaluations against unseen attacks, the optimized open-model pipeline generalized better than a leading proprietary frontier model configuration.
bullets: The agentic system operates in a four-stage closed loop: execute and capture, process and reconstruct, generate and validate, and retest and adapt.
The defensive harness combines six mechanisms: schema knowledge base, telemetry grounding, specialized detection authoring, artifact linting, detection replay, and independent review.
CrowdStrike fine-tuned Nemotron 3 Super into NL2LogScale using 9,349 detection-generation and repair examples, alongside reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards via NVIDIA NeMo Gym.
The optimized open configuration utilized NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra for defensive orchestration and the fine-tuned Nemotron 3 Super for detection generation.
In live-fire testing against eight unseen attacks, the open pipeline produced detections that generalized better and were the only ones to qualify as gold tier.

The startup also announced a $10 million pre-seed funding round led by Llama Ventures.
bullets: Orbis streams 4K video at 24 fps in real time, avoiding the quality and color drift typical of long-duration generation.
The model uses a latent world model during inference to score candidate futures, steering output toward physical plausibility.
Users can modify prompts mid-generation and the environment updates instantly without restarting the render.
A latent memory structure embeds physics frame-by-frame, lowering compute requirements for long-form egocentric video.
Future engineering roadmap includes scaling model and data size, adding tactile sensor data, and incorporating precise action descriptions for robotics training.

items.summary: This guide outlines a practical framework for sizing GPU infrastructure for AI inference by evaluating token patterns, concurrency, cache hit rates, and latency targets. It details a core-and-flex deployment strategy and demonstrates model compression techniques like FP8 post-training quantization, depth/width pruning, and knowledge distillation to lower memory footprints and infrastructure costs.
bullets: Map use cases to token patterns: Chatbots require long inputs and short outputs, AI agents demand extreme long contexts (>128k tokens), and content generation relies on short inputs and long outputs.
Implement a core-and-flex model using reserved or on-prem GPU capacity for steady-state workloads and elastic public cloud spot instances to handle demand surges.
Apply Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) to reduce model weight precision from FP16 to FP8/INT8, cutting memory usage by 25-50% without retraining.
Use NVIDIA ModelOpt for rapid FP8 calibration and conversion, reducing Llama-3.1-8B memory footprint from 16.06GB to 9.08GB.

Execute depth and width pruning alongside knowledge distillation via the NVIDIA NeMo framework to compress models further (e.g., trimming layers or shrinking hidden dimensions) while recovering accuracy.

items.title: Eurafrica
items.subtitle: La storia del progetto coloniale di unire Europa e Africa e del tentativo postbellico di parità
items.original_title: Eurafrica
items.summary: Il saggio analizza l'evoluzione del concetto geopolitico di Eurafrica dal Novecento in poi. Esamina sia i progetti coloniali europei di sfruttamento e colonizzazione demografica sia il tentativo postbellico dei deputati africani e caraibici di ribaltare il sistema dall'interno chiedendo cittadinanza e diritti in una comunità transnazionale paritaria.
bullets: Il progetto originario dell'Eurafrica, sviluppato dagli anni Dieci del Novecento e teorizzato da figure come Richard Coudenhove-Kalergi, mirava alla pacificazione e alla ricostruzione economica europea attraverso lo sfruttamento delle risorse e dei territori coloniali africani.

Il concetto geopolitico era basato su una netta asimmetria razziale ed economica, in cui l'Africa era considerata esclusivamente come una risorsa per risolvere i problemi demografici e industriali interni dell'Europa.
Piani estremi come quello di 'Atlantropa' ideato da Herman Sörgel prevedevano persino la costruzione di dighe per abbassare il Mediterraneo e unire fisicamente i due continenti.

All'indomani della Seconda guerra mondiale, l'Union française permise a leader come Félix Houphouët-Boigny, Aimé Césaire e Léopold Senghor di lottare per l'abolizione dei lavori forzati, l'estensione della cittadinanza e la creazione di uno Stato postnazionale egualitario.
Il fallimento di questa visione paritaria e universalista ha lasciato spazio all'affermazione dei nazionalismi e a un discorso decoloniale ridotto a particolarismo identitario.

bullets: Dopo la morte del figlio Arthur nel 2015, Nick Cave ha evitato i cliché narrativi del lutto rinnovando radicalmente la sua produzione artistica.

A differenza di chi recide i propri legami per cambiare vita, Cave si è trasformato mantenendo intatta la propria memoria e restando nello stesso corpo.
Durante un'intervista sul disco Skeleton Tree, Cave ha ridefinito il concetto di dolore, affermando che la perdita è appartenuta anche al figlio stesso.

bullets: Robots require end-of-arm tooling (EOAT) with adjustable parameters to handle real-world variations in part sizes, shapes, and materials.
Manipulation depends on physical variables like friction, slip, and deformation that cannot be fully modeled in simulation, making physical feedback critical.

items.summary: Europe's push to build AI factories and data centers is creating an immediate surge in demand for advanced semiconductors, directly contradicting its goals for technological sovereignty. Because the bloc produces fewer than 10 percent of the world's chips and lacks advanced fabrication and packaging capabilities, its new infrastructure relies heavily on U.S. designers like Nvidia and Asian manufacturers. As lawmakers prepare Chips Act 2.0 to address this gap through demand-side measures, experts warn that the strategy risks trading Asian manufacturing chokepoints for deep dependence on U.S. hardware and software ecosystems.
bullets: The European Court of Auditors warns that the original Chips Act target of capturing 20 percent of global semiconductor production by 2030 is unlikely to be met, with current projections resting around 11.7 percent.

Planned E.U. AI infrastructure requires massive computing power: CEPS estimates each AI factory needs up to 25,000 advanced chips, while gigafactories require at least 100,000, driving reliance on Nvidia hardware and CUDA software.
Taiwan produces roughly 90 percent of the world's most advanced chips, and the E.U. holds just 4 percent of the market in packaging, assembly, and testing.
While Europe hosts critical infrastructure players like ASML and research center Imec, it lacks end-to-end supply chain autonomy across design, fabrication, and materials.
Experts emphasize that true sovereignty requires resilience and diversified suppliers to avoid geopolitical leverage points, rather than attempting unachievable complete self-sufficiency.

items.original_title: The First Battery Was Inspired By a Dead Frog
items.summary: Alessandro Volta invented the first chemical battery in 1799, known as the voltaic pile, by stacking alternating copper and zinc discs separated by moisture-soaked paper. This invention emerged from a scientific debate with Luigi Galvani regarding animal versus metallic electricity. Unlike Leyden jars that released brief discharges, Volta's pile delivered a sustained low-current output generated through chemical reactions.
bullets: Luigi Galvani used electrostatic generators in the 1770s and 1780s to stimulate dissected frog legs, concluding that animals possessed an innate 'animal electricity'.
Alessandro Volta argued that the frog merely acted as an electroscope and that the electrical charge originated from the contact of two different metals.
Volta built the voltaic pile using stacked discs of copper and zinc separated by cardboard, blotting paper, or cloth soaked in brine or acid.
The voltaic pile differed from Leyden jars by generating continuous electricity via chemical reactions rather than just storing and discharging static charge.
Early piles suffered from moisture loss when users stacked too many metal discs to increase power output.
Volta's invention enabled Nicholson and Carlisle to discover chemical electrolysis by splitting water into hydrogen and oxygen.

items.title: How AI Is Changing Code Reviews & Software Development

items.original_title: How AI Is Changing Code Reviews & Software Development
items.summary: The evolution of software code reviews has progressed through four major eras: the Fagan structural inspection era, the Agile paired programming era, the pull request consensus era, and the CI/CD automation era. With the introduction of LLMs and AI development tools, reviews are shifting from implementation syntax to outcome reviews. AI handles broad analysis, code generation, and checking, while human engineers set context, make trade-offs, and validate business intent.
bullets: Fagan Era: Early structured, team-based line-by-line code inspections focusing heavily on implementation and syntax correctness.
Agile Era: Paired programming introduced on-the-fly, real-time reviews to accelerate development velocity.
Pull Era: Version control repos introduced pull requests, diffs, and consensus-based merge approvals among teams.
Automation Era: CI/CD pipelines added system-assisted checks for code quality, security vulnerabilities, and regulatory compliance.
AI Era: LLMs enable a transition from reviewing implementation syntax to validating business outcomes, intent, and requirement fulfillment.
Division of Labor: AI performs broad analysis and generates code, docs, and architecture, while humans set context, make trade-offs, and apply judgment.

items.original_title: Cosa può insegnarci un terremoto
items.summary: Analisi dell'auto-organizzazione civica nata in seguito al terremoto del Friuli del 1976. L'articolo esamina come il capitale sociale e i comitati di borgata abbiano guidato la risposta all'emergenza e la ricostruzione materiale e politica, offrendo un modello di azione collettiva applicabile anche alle crisi climatiche contemporanee.
bullets: Il terremoto del 6 maggio 1976 in Friuli provocò 990 vittime e quasi 100.000 sfollati, innescando però una risposta comunitaria immediata e non organizzata che smentisce l'idea di isolamento ed egoismo post-disastro.

Nella borgata di Godo (Gemona), i comitati locali si organizzarono autonomamente per distribuire gli aiuti primari, gestire le tendopoli e presentare richieste mirate grazie a una profonda conoscenza del tessuto sociale.
Il 25 maggio 1976 l'85% degli aventi diritto partecipò a un'assemblea generale per eleggere un comitato di delegati con mandato imperativo, mantenendo l'assemblea come organo sovrano.

A differenza dei gruppi di emergenza temporanei studiati in letteratura, i comitati friulani nacquero da legami di vicinato preesistenti per gestire l'intera fase di ricostruzione e sviluppare un'agency politica.

Il conflitto con le istituzioni e i corpi intermedi tradizionali (partiti e sindacati) culminò nella manifestazione autonoma di Trieste del 16 luglio 1976, guidata esclusivamente dalla int (la gente-popolo).

La letteratura scientifica e i dati sui disastri climatici confermano che la gestione diretta della ricostruzione da parte delle comunità locali produce esiti migliori, sebbene oggi la disgregazione dei legami sociali renda difficile replicare tale modello.

bullets: I modelli di linguaggio continueranno a evolvere tramite scaling e reinforcement learning, smentendo le previsioni cicliche di plateau.
Il possesso di un corpo fisico non è un prerequisito per l'intelligenza artificiale, ma anzi rappresenta un vincolo umano da limitare per preservare la sicurezza.
Nel settore del software, l'uso di agenti basati su IA permetterà a figure non tecniche di automatizzare i processi e creare applicazioni senza mediazione.
La concentrazione del valore si sposterà verso chi sa decidere cosa fare a livello strategico, riducendo drasticamente la richiesta di intermediari tecnici e legali.
La transizione economica genererà una fase critica per la tenuta psicologica della forza lavoro prima di un eventuale nuovo ordine sociale.

Her race culminated in a high-stakes tactical battle down the final descents under pressure from surrounding competitors.
bullets: Adopted a conservative start, placing 16th to 17th at the Les Contamines aid station (30k mark) to preserve energy before the night section.
Experienced early concern about overcooking her pace when she noticed she was steadily catching runners prior to reaching Courmayeur.
Shifted from climbing efficiently to managing downhill risks, noting that she still feels more cautious on descents in ultra-distance events.
Relied on inaccurate time gaps reported by trail hikers, which kept her constantly worried about being caught from behind rather than focusing solely on hunting down second place.

items.title: Why Does AI Need Access to the Web?
items.subtitle: How web infrastructure layers prevent AI hallucinations and stale data.
items.original_title: Why Does AI Need Access to the Web?
items.summary: Large language models suffer from hallucinations and outdated outputs because their training data freezes at release. To build reliable production agents, systems need a dedicated web infrastructure layer that supplies real-time, structured context from the internet.
bullets: Pre-trained LLM weights freeze at the end of training, leaving models blind to new products, prices, laws, and current events.
Without real-time data, AI agents fail confidently at scale, propagating errors through multi-agent workflows in a garbage-in, garbage-out dynamic.
Direct web scraping by LLMs fails due to anti-bot technologies, CAPTCHAs, and the messy, human-centric nature of raw HTML.
A robust web infrastructure layer must provide five core elements: grounded citations, deep context, freshness, correct formatting, and low latency.
Different data types decay at different rates; while product specifications are static, prices and stock availability require real-time inference refreshing.

US collegiate programs produce world-class runners using precise training methodologies like double threshold.

While cultural and racing adaptations can be difficult, foreign athletes like Brian Musau and Habtom Samuel have significantly improved their pedigrees in the NCAA.

Le attrezzature tecniche erano rudimentali: tre amplificatori Vox da 100 watt del tutto incapaci di coprire i 130 decibel di volume generati dal pubblico urlante.
La scaletta consisteva in undici brani per una durata di trenta minuti esatti, senza alcun brano tratto dai recenti album rivoluzionari come Revolver.

La separazione portò i quattro membri a intraprendere strade individuali e geograficamente distinte, tra l'India, la Spagna e la Francia.

items.title: Gli n-gram in Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
items.subtitle: Come Qwen usa tabelle statiche e hashing a 16 vie per alleggerire il calcolo
items.original_title: Gli n-gram di Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
items.summary: Il modello Qwen 3.8 Flash Next introduce una tecnica basata su n-gram per alleggerire il carico computazionale. Invece di costringere il modello a ricostruire concetti complessi composti da più token all'interno della rete principale, un sistema di hashing e lookup statico arricchisce direttamente il vettore del token al secondo layer. Questa architettura sposta 51 miliardi di parametri fuori dalla VRAM pesante e dalle moltiplicazioni matriciali intensive.
bullets: La tecnica utilizza funzioni di hashing fisse applicate agli ultimi due o tre token in input per interrogare un database statico di 51 miliardi di parametri.
Il recupero dei dati avviene durante l'inferenza del primo layer, mascherando completamente la latenza di accesso.
L'hashing viene suddiviso in 16 vie per ricomporre vettori da circa 2500 componenti, limitando le collisioni tra concetti diversi.
Al secondo layer, una matrice specifica decide quanto arricchire lo stato interno del token corrente con il significato estratto dalla tabella statica.
I parametri aggiuntivi non aumentano la KV Cache e non pesano sulla computazione matriciale densa, liberando capacità del modello per compiti più complessi.

items.summary: Virtual power plants (VPPs) aggregate household devices like smart thermostats, EV chargers, and home batteries to reduce grid load during peak hours. Utilities incentivize participation with bill discounts and bonuses, while participants retain override controls. Evaluating a VPP involves checking device compatibility, understanding household flexibility, and reviewing data privacy policies.
bullets: VPPs aggregate connected household devices to scale down electricity demand during peak hours, acting as a distributed alternative to traditional power plants.
Financial incentives range from $50 to $150 initially plus annual bonuses for smart thermostats, to hundreds or thousands of dollars annually for EVs and home batteries.

Enrollment typically requires checking utility compatibility via terms like 'demand response' or 'peak rewards,' or signing up directly through device apps from manufacturers like EV makers or thermostat brands.
Participation requires schedule flexibility, as utilities may periodically throttle energy use or shift charging times.
Programs typically feature opt-out mechanisms allowing users to override controls for immediate needs like unexpected guests or road trips.
Data collection focuses on asset status and energy draw, though privacy advocates note potential tracking of household routines.

items.original_title: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
items.summary: The Open ASR Leaderboard introduces Monsoon en-IN and Monsoon hi-IN datasets to address geographic, demographic, and orthographic gaps in automatic speech recognition evaluation. By incorporating 12 speaker attributes across hundreds of districts and introducing Orthographically-Informed Word Error Rate (OIWER) for Hindi, the benchmark reveals hidden performance variances between models that look identical on aggregate word error rates.
bullets: Adds speaker-disjoint evaluation sets covering 4,888 speakers across Indian English and Hindi, tracking 12 demographic and recording attributes per speaker.
Designed to vary across nine axes including geography, device types, acoustic environments, speech rate, and age to expose failure modes hidden by aggregate metrics.
Replaces standard single-string references for Hindi with an orthographic lattice to prevent models from being penalized for valid spelling variants.
Introduces the Orthographically-Informed Word Error Rate (OIWER) metric for Hindi to score recognition independently of arbitrary orthographic choices.
Demonstrates that models with nearly identical overall word error rates can exhibit substantial performance swings (up to 1.68 WER points) when segmented by regional accents and demographics.

items.original_title: Planetary prediction engine: Automating global models via Earth AI
items.summary: Google Research introduces the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous system powered by LLMs that executes full geospatial prediction workflows from natural-language queries. The system automates data discovery, feature engineering, and model training, using opaque handles to pass artifacts between modular stages and bypass LLM context limits. Evaluations show significant performance gains across public health indicators, FEMA risk indices, food security downscaling, and real-time disease outbreak forecasting.
bullets: Decomposes the predictive workflow into three LLM-orchestrated modular stages passing artifacts via opaque handles to avoid context-window limits.
Achieved a mean R² of 76.8% across 21 CDC health indicators compared to 60.0% for manual expert pipelines.
Doubled baseline accuracy when downscaling food security from provincial (ADM1) to local government (ADM2) levels in Nigeria (R² of 66.1% vs. 31.5%).
Reached a Recall@10 of 83.3% during the 2026 Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the DRC, improving 10.3 percentage points over a Bayesian baseline.
Combines structured statistical covariates with latent foundation model embeddings like AlphaEarth Foundations to capture non-linear patterns.

Review processes adapted to leverage AI tools like GitHub Copilot to parse diffs and assess generated code.

Security strategies focused on reducing core dependencies, auditing supply chains, and establishing direct relationships with dependency maintainers.

items.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
items.subtitle: Build and finetune ColBERT-style late-interaction retrieval models using Sentence Transformers.
items.original_title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
items.summary: This guide covers training and finetuning multi-vector embedding models (ColBERT-style late interaction) using Sentence Transformers. It explains architectural components, loss functions like CachedMultiVectorMultipleNegativesRankingLoss, dataset formatting, and evaluation using a medical retrieval use case that outperforms general-purpose models.
bullets: Multi-vector models use a token-level MaxSim operator instead of a single vector dot product, preserving fine-grained domain signals that are otherwise averaged away.
Unsupervised checkpoints (like lightonai/mLateOn-unsupervised) adapt better to new domains during finetuning than fully supervised finished checkpoints.
GradCache decouples effective batch sizes from GPU memory limitations by encoding documents in chunks.
Contrastive losses for multi-vector models require a scale of 1.0 rather than dense models' 20.0 to prevent softmax saturation.
Training a domain-specific model on 1 million pairs for 14.5 hours on an RTX 3090 achieved top performance on medical retrieval benchmarks, beating dense and lexical baselines.

items.title: 10 AI Lessons from Driving 200+ Million Fully Autonomous Miles

items.original_title: 10 AI Lessons from Driving 200+ Million Fully Autonomous Miles
items.summary: Waymo details ten core architectural and operational insights derived from accumulating over 200 million fully autonomous vehicle miles. The piece covers sensor fusion, foundation model consolidation, safety validation layers, and simulation methodologies necessary for scaling Level 4 autonomy.
bullets: Multimodal sensor fusion combining cameras (semantics), lidar (3D geometry), and radar (velocity and penetration through weather) is required for safe full autonomy.
High-definition maps serve as a reliable prior memory, allowing onboard compute to dedicate real-time processing to dynamic changes.
Consolidating modular detection code into fewer, high-capacity foundation models leverages scaling laws while avoiding unmaintainable pipeline complexity.
An independent, physics-based safety validation layer acts as a hard backstop against black-box neural network failures.
Large-scale closed-loop simulation enables the testing of rare edge cases by allowing surrounding traffic to react dynamically to vehicle actions.
A 'thinking fast and slow' architecture uses fast sensor fusion for real-time control alongside Vision-Language Models for deep reasoning in complex scenarios.

items.title: How to Evaluate LLMs Before Production
items.subtitle: Learn concrete engineering practices for robust LLM evaluation.
items.original_title: How to evaluate LLMs before production
items.summary: Moving LLM systems to production requires shifting from clean benchmarks to evaluation pipelines that reflect real-world ambiguity, maintain strict safety constraints, and isolate variables. By treating offline evaluation like integration testing and combining error analysis with LLM-as-judge triage, teams can systematically measure improvements without relying on flawed aggregate metrics.
bullets: Define success criteria using a three-level hierarchy: primary outcomes (precision), safety constraints (recall), and operational guardrails (latency, cost, reliability).

Treat offline evaluation like end-to-end integration testing, changing one major variable at a time (prompt, model, input construction, or pipeline logic) while recording complete baseline configurations.
Preserve production-like ambiguity and distractions in offline data, avoiding clean datasets that exclude complex edge cases or multiple candidate variables.
Treat production labels as noisy workflow signals rather than absolute ground truth, accounting for developer behaviors like rotating credentials or clearing alerts to unblock work.
Use LLM-as-judge for triage to automatically process clear cases, route low-confidence or high-impact samples to human reviewers, and track judge-system disagreements.

items.subtitle: Come funzionano i controller MIDI indossabili realizzati dal musicista Marculedu.
items.original_title: Costruirsi un nuovo corpo per fare musica
items.summary: Il musicista Marculedu sperimenta la creazione di strumenti musicali indossabili, unendo programmazione e componenti hardware per trasformare i movimenti corporei in segnali MIDI. Attraverso sensori di pressione e Wi-Fi, gestisce synth e campionatori direttamente dal palco.
bullets: Uso di microcontrollori e sensori applicati al corpo per generare controller MIDI personalizzati.
Le unghie musicali sfruttano sensori di pressione sulla falange per attivare trigger sonori tramite algoritmi dedicati.
I dati dei sensori vengono inviati via Wi-Fi a patch su plugdata e mappati su DAW per pilotare synth ed effetti.
La performance dal vivo unisce gesto e suono, riducendo i movimenti al minimo per garantire stabilità e controllo del setup.
La ricerca ha portato alla colonna sonora del cortometraggio Revolver e all'attenzione di artisti internazionali.

items.title: Waymo Expands Autonomous Ride-Hailing to Munich
items.subtitle: Waymo plans to launch commercial robotaxi operations in Munich by late 2027.
items.original_title: Servus München: Waymo is Coming to Germany
items.summary: Waymo is expanding its fully autonomous ride-hailing operations to Munich, Germany, targeting a public launch by the end of 2027. The phased rollout begins with manual driving for high-definition mapping and validation, followed by testing with safety drivers to adapt to local traffic conditions.
bullets: Initial operations involve manual driving in Munich to build high-definition street maps.
Testing will use trained autonomous specialists behind the wheel during the validation phase.
Public commercial ride-hailing service is targeted for launch by the end of 2027.
Company cites safety data across 350 million fully autonomous kilometers, claiming 16x fewer serious injury crashes than human drivers.

items.title: La scimmia sulla schiena: undici canzoni italiane sull'eroina
items.subtitle: Una rassegna di brani della musica italiana che raccontano la dipendenza da eroina.
items.original_title: La scimmia sulla schiena: 11 canzoni italiane che raccontano l'eroina
items.summary: Il testo analizza undici brani della musica italiana che affrontano il tema della dipendenza da eroina, attingendo a diverse epoche e generi musicali. Vengono esaminati testi di cantautori e gruppi storici che descrivono l'impatto della sostanza, l'astinenza e le storie di periferia.
bullets: Antonello Venditti racconta in 'Lilly' la storia di una giovane dipendente attraverso il riferimento ai quattro buchi nella pelle.
Fabrizio De André si ispira alla poesia 'Eroina' di Riccardo Mannerini per il suo 'Cantico dei drogati'.
Eugenio Finardi descrive in 'Scimmia' le sensazioni fisiche e psicologiche del primo utilizzo e l'illusione del controllo.
Luca Carboni e gli 883 inseriscono nei loro brani il tema della dipendenza come elemento di cronaca generazionale e provinciale.
Brani come 'Per Elisa' di Alice e 'Canzone di Natale' degli Zen Circus offrono letture metaforiche o realistiche dell'emarginazione legata alla droga.

items.title: Il riconoscimento in Shrek e Fiona
items.subtitle: Analisi filosofica della dinamica di accettazione e identità in Shrek e Fiona.
items.original_title: Shrek e Fiona: Non basta essere accettati, abbiamo bisogno di essere riconosciuti
items.summary: Il saggio analizza la dinamica relazionale tra Shrek e Fiona attraverso il concetto di riconoscimento. I due protagonisti superano le maschere imposte dalla società, trovando una felicità basata sulla decostruzione delle aspettative esterne piuttosto che sulla mera accettazione dei difetti.
bullets: La palude di Shrek rappresenta un sistema di difesa contro il giudizio altrui.
Fiona vive intrappolata nel ruolo della principessa conforme alle regole sociali.
L'amore tra i due nasce dalla condivisione di un'autenticità sottratta alle aspettative esterne.
Il riconoscimento reciproco supera la semplice tolleranza o l'approvazione superficiale dei difetti.

items.title: Comau e Invent presentano soluzioni integrate di robotica e intralogistica
items.subtitle: Scopri l'integrazione tra robotica avanzata e software WMS/YMS per la catena di fornitura.
items.original_title: Comau and Invent presented automation and intralogistics solutions at a premier technology and automation summit in Brazil
items.summary: Comau e Invent hanno presentato al vertice Brasil em Código la loro offerta congiunta per l'automazione industriale e l'intralogistica. L'evento ha mostrato l'integrazione tra l'ingegneria robotica avanzata, i sistemi di esoscheletri per la riduzione dello sforzo fisico e i software di gestione logistica come WMS e YMS.
bullets: Presentazione della sinergia tra robotica di nuova generazione e intralogistica avanzata per flussi di lavoro iper-connessi.
Esposizione dell'esoscheletro robotico MATE di Comau, privo di batterie o motori.
L'esoscheletro riduce lo sforzo fisico fino al 50% migliorando l'ergonomia e riducendo l'assenteismo.
Presentazione di soluzioni di intralogistica intelligente tramite software di gestione WMS/YMS e robotica mobile per la movimentazione ad alta densità.

items.title: Dimissioni nel CdA dell'ASI e avvio del commissariamento
items.subtitle: Tre membri del CdA dell'ASI si dimettono, aprendo la strada al commissariamento dell'ente.
items.original_title: Agenzia Spaziale Italiana: dimissioni di tre componenti del Consiglio di Amministrazione
items.summary: La vicepresidente vicaria e due consiglieri dell'Agenzia Spaziale Italiana hanno rassegnato le dimissioni, provocando la decadenza del Consiglio di amministrazione. Tale decisione apre la strada al commissariamento dell'ente e alla nomina di un nuovo presidente, in vista di importanti impegni nazionali e internazionali.
bullets: La vicepresidente vicaria Elda Turco Bulgherini e i consiglieri Stefano Gualandris e Stefano Arcifa si sono dimessi.
Le dimissioni determinano la decadenza del Consiglio di amministrazione dell'ASI.
L'ente è rimasto privo della figura apicale dopo la scomparsa del presidente Teodoro Valente.
Il commissariamento permetterà di nominare un nuovo presidente e un CdA rinnovato per i prossimi eventi strategici.

items.title: The Real AI Risk Is Inside the Labs
items.subtitle: Analysis of why frontier lab leaks and centralized control are the true AI risks.
items.original_title: The real AI risk is inside the labs
items.summary: The primary risks of advanced AI stem from internal lab incidents, insider data leaks of closed models, and the concentration of existential decisions in the hands of a few unselected tech executives. Open-weight models present a mild risk compared to these vectors, while restricting open research also harms defensive cybersecurity efforts. Ultimately, governance requires international joint safety organizations rather than unilateral corporate or nationalist policies.
bullets: The first serious AI safety incidents are statistically most likely to happen internally within frontier AI labs during testing phases.
Closed models pose a high leakage risk because a single rogue employee with access can release multi-terabyte weights, mirroring open-source availability.
Restricting open-source AI models hurts defensive cybersecurity by preventing open-source maintainers from utilizing bug-seeking LLMs.
A joint international AI safety organization is needed because individual companies should not independently evaluate whether a model is safe.
Slowing down AI development carries a hidden security and human cost by delaying medical and scientific discoveries that could prevent suffering.
The greatest systemic danger is not geopolitical competition or open weights, but a small group of unselected tech CEOs making unilateral existential decisions.

items.title: Being Linux Torvalds
items.subtitle: How AI changes software engineering by turning developers into project leaders like Linus Torvalds.
items.original_title: Being Linux Torvalds
items.summary: Linus Torvalds' true genius was not just writing the initial Linux kernel, but transitioning early into a project leader and designer who guided a massive codebase through other maintainers. With the advent of AI coding tools, software engineers must adopt this exact leadership and architectural role. Instead of relying on passive vibe coding, expert programmers act as orchestrators, directing LLM agents the way Torvalds managed subsystem maintainers.
bullets: Writing a minimal Unix-like kernel from scratch is a feat achieved by many talented programmers, but Torvalds' differentiator was his subsequent shift to project leadership.
Torvalds stopped writing most code early on, focusing instead on design concepts, maintaining coherence, and communicating with subsystem maintainers.
Effective use of AI in software development mirrors Torvalds' orchestration role rather than passive, automated prompting.
Expert programmers using LLMs must act as architects and directors, setting design hints and selecting which implementations to pursue.
This shift reduces human-related management friction while requiring high-level technical judgment to guide faster, parallel AI work streams.

items.title: Comau acquisisce Invent Smart Intralogistics Solutions
items.subtitle: Comau acquisisce Invent per espandere l'automazione logistica e i software di orchestrazione.
items.original_title: Comau extends its intralogistics platform by acquiring Invent Smart Intralogistics Solutions
items.summary: Comau ha completato l'acquisizione del 100% di Invent Smart Intralogistics Solutions, specialista brasiliano in tecnologie per magazzini e logistica. L'operazione integra il software di orchestrazione guidato dall'intelligenza artificiale di Invent con le tecnologie di stoccaggio di Automha e le competenze di automazione di Comau, creando una piattaforma end-to-end per la gestione dei flussi di materiali.
bullets: L'acquisizione integra le competenze software di Invent con l'ecosistema Comau-Automha per la gestione di magazzini e fulfillment.
Invent apporta competenze specifiche nella gestione delle scatole, nella preparazione degli ordini e nell'orchestrazione logistica, complementari ai sistemi per pallet di Automha.
Il mercato dell'intralogistica è previsto in crescita del 13% annuo nei prossimi 3-5 anni, con picchi del 15% negli Stati Uniti e del 17% in Brasile.
Invent manterrà la propria struttura di gestione e il modello di business esistente, beneficiando della portata globale del gruppo Comau.
L'operazione amplia la presenza di Comau in America Latina e facilita l'accesso al segmento mid-market statunitense per l'automazione logistica.
